Hero_Desc_Maison:
A rest phantom.
She always keeps her emotions calm and has a bizarre side to her where she tries to make herself at home wherever she is and wherever she goes.
It is unknown as to what significance such a personality holds.
Album_Wish_Maison: To play pranks forever in a comfortable place
Album_Maison7: Maison is relatively calm for a ghost. She is mischievous, of course, but seems to have little desire to cause uproar. With a sullen expression, Maison responded, 'A home is a place for comfort, so why turn it into chaos?'
LoveHero_Maison:
Heading out
to see a new house, huh?
Food_ChefNote_Maison_Hate1: She disliked it, saying the flavor lacked the romance of comfort. Apparently, merely looking at it reminded her of Elves rushing around in a panic.
Food_ChefNote_Maison_Hate2: She pushed it away, saying such an extravagant dish disturbed her peace of mind.
Food_ChefNote_Maison_Like1: She ate happily, saying a stack of cans felt strangely satisfying. When she asked for every remaining can, I refused because they needed to be recycled.
Food_ChefNote_Maison_Like2: She noted a faint fishy smell, but said eating it felt like floating on water. It appears to give her a sense of comfort.
Food_ChefNote_Maison_Like3: Saying warm food made her pleasantly drowsy, she pretended to fall asleep on the banquet hall table. I barely managed to drag her away.
Food_ChefNote_Maison_Like4: She giggled that a house built from this cake would be wonderfully sweet, then decided the food was too precious for construction and ate all of it.
Food_ChefNote_Maison_Like5: She abruptly threw it at me, making me sneeze. While I was sneezing, she reviewed it as a dish that delivered both flavor and fun.
Food_ChefNote_Maison_Like6: She asked for songpyeon with a peaceful flavor, so I told her to eat what we had first. She rated them highly, saying every one tasted reassuringly stable.
Food_ChefNote_Maison_Like7: She kneaded it in her hands, saying rolling it around made her feel calm, until its shape was ruined. Then she licked even her palms clean.
Food_ChefNote_Maison_Like8: Calling it an electrifying dish, she laughed with delight after every bite.
Food_ChefNote_Maison_Like9: She poured the candies onto the table, arranged them into a house, then ate them one by one while humming.
Gacha_Result_SpecialLine3_Maison: This house and that house are all mine!
Maison_Growth: Yes, I am Maison, the homeowner. What brings you here?
Maison_Growth1: Feels like the world has become my home!
Maison_Victory1: This is where our home ends.
Maison_Affinity1_1: I am going to rest for a long while before leaving. Make yourself comfortable!
Maison_Affinity1_2: How can I put my mind more at ease? Not your mind, Master. Mine.
Maison_Affinity2: Where do you feel most comfortable here, Master? Even if you say my spot looks comfortable, I will not give it up.
Maison_Affinity1_3: I envy Werebeasts who fall asleep as soon as their heads touch something. They may lack sensitivity, but perhaps they make up for it by being carefree?
Maison_Affinity3: Why did Alice and Rim insist on building houses? Is it not more comfortable to think of everywhere as your own home?
Maison_Affinity4: It will not be easy to surprise me. Go on, give it a try.
Maison_Affinity5: Why would a home need documents?
Maison_Affinity6: Peace and quiet is nice, but boredom is no fun~ What a dilemma~
Maison_Affinity7: I wish Shaydi's subspace were my home. It is the most entertaining place of all, after all.
Maison_Equipment: I can use it as decoration.
Maison_HeroUpgrade: Maybe I can expand the house a bit?
Maison_Touch1_1: This won't make me sell my home!
Maison_Touch1_2: I thought I'd be safe here?!
Maison_Touch2: Hmm... wonder if there's any magic for head-patting?
Maison_Touch2_2: My home is wherever you are with me, Master.
Maison_No3: That is not it, you know?
Maison_Sorrow1: This is not going very well.
Maison_Birthday: A birthday? I will invite you to my sanctuary too, Master.
Maison_Line2: A roof like the sky, a floor like the earth.
Maison_Line3: There are a lot of guests.
Maison_Lobby: I thought there was a good site nearby.
LoveLetter_Maison:
Ah~ Master. I am waiting for the day when I can make the Order my home... but for now, overturning the fact that it is your home seems difficult.
Someday I should visit a real estate office near the Order and obtain at least a copy of the deed.
If I later come and go through the Order while pretending it is my home, you will not scold me, right?
LoveCall_Maison:
Master? Where are you right now?
Ah... Are you perhaps in my house? The place called the Order.
My plan to make the Order my home has not changed.
I have merely postponed it because I seem to have found an even better house.

There was a cozy cabin in the Werebeast Village.
It was quiet and peaceful, so I simply claimed it as my home.
But... for reasons I do not understand, you always look after me, so I will make you an offer.
I will put the cabin under joint ownership with you.
Do not misunderstand. Joint. Ownership. Understood?
It does not belong to you alone. It will be a home the two of us create together.
Are you not curious what it is like? No ghost chooses a better location than I do.
You may look forward to it. Now stop wasting time and come immediately.
If you are late, I will change the passcode! Hehe.
Affinity_Maison_EP01_001: Master, what do you think a home is?
Affinity_Maison_EP01_002: A place where you feel comfortable.
Affinity_Maison_EP01_003: Right? So anywhere I feel comfortable is my home.
Affinity_Maison_EP01_004: A place where you need proof that you own it.
Affinity_Maison_EP01_005: But a scrap of proof does not put your heart at ease.
Affinity_Maison_EP01_006: Anywhere you can lie down is home.
Affinity_Maison_EP01_007: That sounds tempting. If I lie down here, does this become my home?
Affinity_Maison_EP02_001: Should I just wander into any old place and insist it is my home?
Affinity_Maison_EP02_003: But I am already inside. What are you going to do? Should I insist or not?
Affinity_Maison_EP02_004: It is fine if the homeowner agrees.
Affinity_Maison_EP02_005: How polite. Aside from having to go around finding out who the homeowner is.
Affinity_Maison_EP02_007: I like that proactive attitude. Then I will make this place my home too, all right?
Affinity_Maison_EP03_001: I do not need a knife. I always carry something that can cut.
Affinity_Maison_EP03_002: Just do not scratch the Banquet Hall table.
Affinity_Maison_EP03_003: What is wrong with a few scratches? That much is an acceptable cost.
Affinity_Maison_EP03_004: I think that dagger is stylish.
Affinity_Maison_EP03_005: Right? I sharpen and polish it whenever I am bored.
Affinity_Maison_EP03_006: You washed it properly, did you not?
Affinity_Maison_EP03_007: I think scrubbing it on your clothes would make it even cleaner. Could you bring your clothes over here?
Affinity_Maison_EP04_001: I wonder why everyone gets excited and angry so easily.
Affinity_Maison_EP04_002: Some people are simply more emotionally excitable than others.
Affinity_Maison_EP04_003: Hmm~ What an exemplary answer. Still, watching them can be rather entertaining.
Affinity_Maison_EP04_004: Do I seem like someone who gets excited easily?
Affinity_Maison_EP04_005: I think I would have to get to know you better before I could tell. I will visit often and think about it.
Affinity_Maison_EP04_006: You get excited when you play pranks too.
Affinity_Maison_EP04_007: That is more like a ghost's instinct, so that answer is far too boring.
Affinity_Maison_EP05_002: I think she is an extraordinary ghost.
Affinity_Maison_EP05_003: Right? Shaydi is the only ghost capable of throwing all of Elias into an uproar!
Affinity_Maison_EP05_004: Even if you tried to imitate her, you would never measure up to Shaydi.
Affinity_Maison_EP05_005: Why would I imitate her? I can simply watch and enjoy myself.
Affinity_Maison_EP05_006: What is so great about Shaydi?
Affinity_Maison_EP05_007: Hmm. For starters, the inside of her subspace is incredible. There is endless darkness and an enormous arena.
Affinity_Maison_EP06_001: Master, have you ever felt true repose?
Affinity_Maison_EP06_002: I feel rather at peace when I tidy the Banquet Hall.
Affinity_Maison_EP06_003: So you are the type who calms down while cleaning? I suppose there are people like that.
Affinity_Maison_EP06_004: I think I would feel more at peace if you left.
Affinity_Maison_EP06_005: Are you saying I am in the way right now? You do not have to say it quite so bluntly.
Affinity_Maison_EP06_006: When you are here, I feel at ease too.
Affinity_Maison_EP06_007: Oh, I rather like that answer. I will take it to mean I may settle down here.
Affinity_Maison_EP07_001: What I am attached to is not the physical form of a house.
Affinity_Maison_EP07_002: Is that why you go around everywhere insisting each place is your home?
Affinity_Maison_EP07_003: I am not causing that much harm. Do you really need to be so sharp about it?
Affinity_Maison_EP07_004: Something can be a home even without a physical form.
Affinity_Maison_EP07_005: Right? Why bother giving it a shape at all?
Affinity_Maison_EP07_006: Can something really be a home without having a form?
Affinity_Maison_EP07_007: What an interesting question. Is there even a clearly defined shape that a home must have?
Affinity_Maison_EP08_001: I do not like the tower. I can never settle down there.
Affinity_Maison_EP08_002: It does tend to feel chilly and desolate.
Affinity_Maison_EP08_003: Cold enough for even a ghost to feel the chill... Is that a talent of some kind?
Affinity_Maison_EP08_004: Exactly. I do not like that place at all either.
Affinity_Maison_EP08_005: We think alike. Why do you not go there without me?
Affinity_Maison_EP08_006: I have a whole pile of invitations from Rim. Do you want them?
Affinity_Maison_EP08_007: Just looking at those invitations makes me feel cold, so put them away for now.
Affinity_Maison_EP09_001: It will not be easy to make me angry.
Affinity_Maison_EP09_002: You would get angry if I took that plate away from you.
Affinity_Maison_EP09_003: But I already finished eating. Taking away an empty plate is basic Banquet Hall etiquette.
Affinity_Maison_EP09_004: If it is not easy, that means it is still possible, right?
Affinity_Maison_EP09_005: Well, yes. It is not as if I never get angry.
Affinity_Maison_EP09_006: Lucky you. I want to become a Master who does not get angry easily too.
Affinity_Maison_EP09_007: I like seeing Master angry. It is quite entertaining.
Affinity_Maison_EP10_001: Please serve me the dish that suits me best.
Affinity_Maison_EP10_002: Hmm, I will think about it. Until the next time you come.
Affinity_Maison_EP10_003: You have a talent for making 'come back again' sound so lovely. I like it.
Affinity_Maison_EP10_005: Hmm. Still water puts my mind at ease, so I will give it fifty points.
Affinity_Maison_EP10_006: Please leave once you have finished eating.
Affinity_Maison_EP10_007: I do not want to. Once a ghost sits down, it is up to the ghost when she gets back up~
Affinity_Maison_EP11_001: Being a ghost does not mean I never get tired.
Affinity_Maison_EP11_002: Of course you can get tired.
Affinity_Maison_EP11_003: Right? Even thinking up pranks is no easy task.
Affinity_Maison_EP11_004: Do your brains get overloaded too?
Affinity_Maison_EP11_005: Overloaded? Brains? I do not really know what you mean. Are you saying Master wants to become my subordinate?
Affinity_Maison_EP11_006: Ghosts are usually the ones making everyone else tired.
Affinity_Maison_EP11_007: Being tired does not cause any serious problems, does it? It is all just a passing prank.
Affinity_Maison_EP12_001: Is there a kind of comfort you gain from cooking?
Affinity_Maison_EP12_002: There is the comfort of knowing I disposed of the ingredients.
Affinity_Maison_EP12_003: That is the state of mind you cook in? The food I just ate suddenly tastes worse.
Affinity_Maison_EP12_004: My mind feels at ease while I am cooking.
Affinity_Maison_EP12_005: There is a comfort in keeping busy. I suppose Master is rather diligent?
Affinity_Maison_EP12_006: Seeing all of you eat well puts my mind at ease.
Affinity_Maison_EP12_007: Hmm~ An answer like that makes me want to give you a favorable review. What should I do?
Affinity_Maison_EP13_001: That plate looks comfortable. Everywhere I stand is my home, so should I climb on top of it?
Affinity_Maison_EP13_003: Something that simple is easy for a ghost. Shall I try standing on it?
Affinity_Maison_EP13_004: Would you like a larger plate?
Affinity_Maison_EP13_005: Are you considering my comfort? I was a little moved just now.
Affinity_Maison_EP13_006: Get your feet off that plate!
Affinity_Maison_EP13_007: Oh! What could possibly happen from putting my feet on it for a moment? Do you not wash your dishes, Master?
Affinity_Maison_EP14_001: How am I supposed to balance boredom and comfort?
Affinity_Maison_EP14_002: Comfort can be a little boring. You just have to accept it.
Affinity_Maison_EP14_003: I am saying I am bored right now. Play with me!
Affinity_Maison_EP14_004: Can you not simply do whatever your heart desires?
Affinity_Maison_EP14_005: That is right, is it not? If I get tired of being comfortable, I may make a little mess, right?
Affinity_Maison_EP14_006: Shall we summon the Ghost of Order and ask her?
Affinity_Maison_EP14_007: Ah! Do not call her! Just thinking about her makes me cold!
Affinity_Maison_EP15_003: I know. Is the plate not a little too hard?
Affinity_Maison_EP15_005: You were serving food in your bare hands? This restaurant's hygiene is dreadful.
Affinity_Maison_EP15_007: You served water on a plate? This place has unusual service.
Affinity_Maison_EP16_001: I never intended to travel around with the others, but somehow that is what happened.
Affinity_Maison_EP16_002: It is nice seeing all of you together.
Affinity_Maison_EP16_003: Right? Beru and Sari are rather entertaining ghosts.
Affinity_Maison_EP16_004: Really? Who do you travel with?
Affinity_Maison_EP16_005: Beru and Sari. One causes the commotion, and the other supplies the reactions.
Affinity_Maison_EP16_006: Do they want to travel with you too?
Affinity_Maison_EP16_007: What are they going to do if they do not want to? I will do as I please.
Affinity_Maison_EP17_001: What is it? You look as if you do not like my style.
Affinity_Maison_EP17_002: Of course not. I was just wondering whether today's food was a little salty.
Affinity_Maison_EP17_003: It was a little salty. I thought you had a complaint about me, but you were reflecting on your cooking? Good.
Affinity_Maison_EP17_004: Of course I do. But can you even see your food through those bangs?
Affinity_Maison_EP17_005: This is all part of my style. You truly do not understand a thing.
Affinity_Maison_EP17_006: Of course I do. I was looking at the food on the corner of your mouth.
Affinity_Maison_EP17_007: There is something there? Leave it. I will eat it as a palate cleanser on my way out.
Affinity_Maison_EP18_001: Ah~ I am full. I think I will lie down right here today.
Affinity_Maison_EP18_003: I mean that is how I feel. Just take it to mean I am in a good mood.
Affinity_Maison_EP18_004: Would you like me to lay out a blanket too?
Affinity_Maison_EP18_005: Hmm? I do not really need one, but I appreciate your spirit of hospitality, so I will accept. You washed it properly, right?
Affinity_Maison_EP18_006: Go to the storeroom. It even has cobwebs, so it is nice and cozy.
Affinity_Maison_EP18_007: What were you doing instead of cleaning, letting the storeroom get that bad? That is too much.
Affinity_Maison_EP19_001: Would you sing me a song? I would like something soothing.
Affinity_Maison_EP19_003: That sounds awfully breathy, does it not? Still, it was not a bad attempt.
Affinity_Maison_EP19_004: I will sing you a lullaby.
Affinity_Maison_EP19_005: Hmm. That is a nice song. But why is Master dozing off while singing it?
Affinity_Maison_EP19_006: I will tap a plate with a fork.
Affinity_Maison_EP19_007: Does that put your mind at ease, Master? May I tap on you for a while too?
Affinity_Maison_EP20_001: I went to Monatium, and there were so many buildings. Everyone looked terribly busy, though.
Affinity_Maison_EP20_002: You are simply far too idle.
Affinity_Maison_EP20_003: What is wrong with being idle? What is so bad about having some peace of mind?
Affinity_Maison_EP20_004: Very few Elves own a building of their own.
Affinity_Maison_EP20_005: Hmm. Does everyone lack a home? That sounds difficult.
Affinity_Maison_EP20_006: A place where you cannot settle down must be uncomfortable.
Affinity_Maison_EP20_007: I am beginning to feel sorry for the Elves. Next time, I suppose I will tease them a little more gently.
